supportPackages.acryl-loopback-http: The plan marks ACRYL's runtime/acryl-loopback-http as replaced by acrylblends/loopback-only. The framework's loopback-only provides the guard (loopbackOnly, loopbackAuthority) but not the private-route composition the workspace's routes are built with (privateApi, ownPage, ownPageSocket, jsonBody, readJson, INVALID_JSON, ReportError). To keep this package's source and tests byte-identical, the same source commit's runtime package is ported beside it under ide/acryl-loopback-http and declared as a workspace dependency. It is not a row of the frame.
